mapper.select:
select t.id, t.code, t.name, t.description, t.duration_days, t.travel_style, t.service_level, t.physical_rating, t.trip_type, t.min_age, t.base_price, t.sale_price, t.single_supplement, t.currency, t.cover_image, t.map_image, t.notes, t.status, t.version, t.seo_title, t.seo_description, t.seo_keywords, t.deleted_at, t.create_dept, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time from holidays_hot_deal_tour h inner join holidays_tour t on t.id = h.tour_id where t.status = 1 and t.deleted_at is null order by h.sort_order asc, h.id asc
limit #{limit}
